Problem two · privacy

Every question you ask cloud AI leaves the room.

Names, schools, marks, locations, worries. Students type all of it into apps that send it to servers they will never see.

1 in 3

Indian schools have no internet connection at all. Cloud AI never reaches them.

UDISE+ 2024-25: 63.5% of schools have internet access
The answer

Meet Buddie.

An AI study companion that runs entirely on the device. No feed. No apps. No internet needed.

Go-to-market

#WiFiOffChallenge

Phase 1 · Tease

Think Offline

Sealed white boxes reach student creators. No logo, no explanation, only a countdown.

Phase 2 · Drop

Wi-Fi off

Creators switch Wi-Fi off on camera and Buddie keeps answering. The challenge spreads through school groups.

Phase 3 · Scale

Classrooms

School demo days, student ambassadors, referrals, and numbered Founder IDs for the first 250 buyers.
